<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece(tag):
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if 70<n['pixels']<100 and n['color'] in ('p','W'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            print(tag,'piece',n['color'],'px',n['pixels'],'rows',min(rs),max(rs),'cols',min(cs),max(cs))
def timer(tag):
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    last=a[63]
    print(tag,'timer c-count',last.count('c'),'B-count',last.count('B'))
piece('start(45deg)'); timer('start')
action(['LEFT'])
piece('after 1 more LEFT (from 45)')
action(['RIGHT'])
piece('after RIGHT')
action(['RIGHT'])
piece('after 2nd RIGHT')
timer('end')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
